notes: The two English ordinals are distributed one to אֶחָד and one to רִאשׁוֹן; the reverse assignment is defensible and is named in the unit note.
The second חֹדֶשׁ, with its preposition and assimilated article, is unrepresented under rule 22: the modified occurrence (הַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן) is the one the ASV renders.

Article count follows rule 29's arthrous case: the rectum's own article takes the written the before its phrase and the construct יוֹם takes a supplied one; the ordinal's agreement article is unrepresented under rule 47.
